primaryChecks.text: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.
primaryChecks.previousContext: And the king commanded all the people, saying, “Keep the Passover to the LORD your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: Moreover the altars that were on the roof of Ahaz’s upper room, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the LORD’s house, the king broke down and beat them there, and cast their dust into the brook Kidron.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: ソロモンの王号を用いた回顧である。分裂後の北王国と混同せず、当節だけから歴史的規模・境界を確定しない。

primaryChecks.text: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 歴代の王を通覧する表現で時代を限定できないためプロフィール適用から除外。

primaryChecks.text: He carried out from there all the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the LORD’s temple, as the LORD had said.
primaryChecks.previousContext: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: ソロモンをイスラエルの王として再度回顧する箇所。初出説明に混ぜず、24:13で初めて読める事実として分離。

wikipediaRead.title: Kingdom of Israel (united monarchy)
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 202–203行は聖書記述上の統一王国をソロモンを含む王代に結び付け、204–209行は存在・規模・年代が議論中と説明する。関連する記事だが、本文中の称号と考古学的に確定した政治領域は同一視しない。

candidateCoordinate.reasonJa: 政治領域の境界も実在の範囲も本文から確定できないため、単一点を表示しない。
